diagnosis: The invoice discrepancy is likely due to mid-cycle proration after the upgrade to Business tier. The first invoice combines a credit for unused days on the old plan and a charge for the new plan, which may temporarily exceed the list price.
reply: The invoice total for INV-88213 reflects a prorated charge for upgrading mid-cycle. When upgrading plans, we credit the remaining days of your previous plan and then charge for the new plan. This can result in a higher first invoice, but future invoices will align with the Business tier pricing. You can review [this article](https://support.example.com/kb-0001) for more details on how proration works.
